items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003

ctx.x: So Paul had him. Because Paul used to hang there all the time. Alec Wilder, the songwriter, would hang out, Mingus would hang out there. But you’d look up you’d see like Jimmy Rowles, you’d see George Coleman, so it was the closest thing to like the legitimate jazz club. Well it was a jazz club.
Just before we move on here, can you — any commercials that might ring a bell with us? I mean I know you’ve done many.
